gloss: meeting up; rendezvous; appointment to meet

definitions.gloss: meeting up; rendezvous; appointment to meet
definitions.explanation: An arranged meeting at a specific time and place. Often used for casual meet-ups with friends or dates.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{待|ま}ち{合|あ}わせ⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Let's meet up in front of the station.

examples.japanese: {待|ま}ち{合|あ}わせ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遅|おく}れて→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧しまった。
examples.english: I was late for our meeting time.

examples.japanese: {待|ま}ち{合|あ}わせ⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}からなくて→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧⟦{迷|まよ}った→迷う：02426_mayou⟧。
examples.english: I got lost because I didn't know the meeting place.

notes:
FORMS:
{待|ま}ち (waiting, from ⟦{待|ま}つ→待つ：00469_matsu⟧) + {合|あ}わせ (combining, from ⟦{合|あ}わせる→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧)
Literally: "waiting and meeting together"

USAGE:
{待|ま}ち{合|あ}わせ is commonly used for arranging to meet someone. It can be used as both a noun and with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ as a verb.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {待|ま}ち{合|あ}わせ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ - to arrange to meet
- {待|ま}ち{合|あ}わせ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ - to meet up (⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb)
- {待|ま}ち{合|あ}わせ⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧ - meeting place
- {待|ま}ち{合|あ}わせ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧ - meeting time

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{待合室|まちあいしつ}→待合室：07373_machiaishitsu⟧ - waiting room
- ⟦{集合|しゅうごう}→集合：03068_shuugou⟧ - gathering, assembly (more formal)
- ⟦{約束|やくそく}→約束：01517_yakusoku⟧ - appointment, promise

REGISTER:
Neutral. Very common in everyday conversation.
